references.label: PRD (decisions D1-D13, FR-1..15, NFR-1..5, WI-1..16 with verified file:line anchors)
PAN-2541 (state plane — sequenced to land first)

narratives.Problem: Pipeline advancement depends on one-shot event triggers and blocking signal calls. When a trigger drops or a call hangs, either no patrol re-derives the obligation, or the patrol that exists is blocked by an inconsistently-checked gate. Fourteen open issues (PAN-2536, 2534, 2524, 2520, 2519, 2518, 2498, 2485, 2486, 2537, 2522, 2503, 2502, 2475) are individual edges of this one gap: gate inconsistency, signal fragility, dispatch gaps, wedge blindness, and two missing reconcilers (labels/read-model, agents-table gc).
narratives.Proposal: Complete the deacon's existing derive-and-re-drive net (NOT a new engine): one shared gate predicate (paused/troubled/stoppedByUser) consulted by every autonomous spawn/resume/rebuild path; durable-first bounded exiting signal CLIs with deterministic post-hoc recovery patrols; the four missing dispatch re-drive branches (re-review staleness, plan→work, stack rebuild, swarm slot requeue); pane-content-aware wedge detection with a modal table (codex rate-limit dialog first); a label/read-model reconciler and scheduled agents-table gc; deterministic cycle-modulo cadence replacing Math.random() gates. Interaction contract for every re-drive: derive obligation from durable state → shared gate predicate → admission gate → act idempotently → count attempt → breaker trips to needs-you. Full design in .pan/drafts/pan-2543.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- The state-plane orphan-branch move (PAN-2541 — separate issue, sequenced first)
- PAN-2469's swarm issue-level state machine beyond the failed-slot strand (WI-8 covers slot death only; PAN-2469 stays open)
- Rewriting the deacon patrol architecture or the PAN-2526 deacon.ts file-size refactor (reconcilers are added within the existing structure)
- New wedge-modal coverage beyond the codex rate-limit dialog (the detector table makes future modals cheap additions as observed)
- Any silent-terminal recovery path (every breaker must trip to needs-you)
- Math.random() cadence gates for correctness-critical recovery

autoDecisions.summary: Lowered the PRD's 16 work items into 21 beads: WI-1 split into gate-predicate / gate-routing / gate-operator-clear, WI-3 into verdict-signal-exit / verdict-patrol-reconcile, WI-8 into swarm-failed-requeue / swarm-recover-gc, WI-10 into codex-modal-detector / model-divergence-check; all other WIs map 1:1.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each split part is independently reviewable and testable (predicate vs its call-site routing vs operator-clear paths; CLI exit discipline vs patrol reconcile; coordinator requeue vs manual recover+gc; detector vs divergence check). Merging them would force reviewers to cross-reference unrelated diffs.

autoDecisions.summary: Only the gate-predicate bead carries requiresInspection: true (fast depth).
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the single foundation bead: six downstream beads encode assumptions about its typed-reason API. Every other bead is a leaf whose defects surface at tests/review, and the PRD has already made all architectural decisions (D1-D13).

autoDecisions.summary: Delivered as one issue with 21 beads rather than sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD NFR-1 is an explicit operator direction: the whole epic ships as one issue, no partial delivery; phases are organizational only.

autoDecisions.summary: PAN-2541 sequencing is recorded as hazard H1 (check before label-reconciler work; pan sync-main after it lands) rather than a plan edge.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is an external cross-issue dependency, not an intra-plan edge; the epic does not hard-block on it because record reads go through read-door helpers either way.

autoDecisions.summary: Cadence choices for WI-13 fixed as: feedback recovery every 5 patrol cycles (~5 min), session/state janitors every 60 cycles (~1 h).
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD names these values in WI-13; feedback recovery is correctness-critical post-WI-3/4, janitors are hygiene.
